details:
FireWatch is a web-based wildfire monitoring dashboard that integrates near-real-time MODIS and VIIRS satellite data from NASA FIRMS. It uses spatial grid harmonization, interactive maps, and historical data visualization to make satellite observations easier to compare and understand. The project aims to improve wildfire awareness and support informed environmental decision-making.

We developed FireWatch using Java, Spring Boot, React, Leaflet, MongoDB Atlas, Docker, and Render. Our creative approach combines observations from different satellite instruments into a unified visualization. Throughout development, we considered data accessibility, performance, security, usability, and deployment costs.
